journey.title: Create and use a first agent
journey.purpose: A person with no account, no Mac and no phone number gets a working agent that has answered them, before being asked for anything. This is the conversion path and its friction budget is the product's most important number.

steps.intent: Understands that a plain description is the only input required.
Types what the agent should do and asks for a draft.
Reads the drafted profile and confirms it.
Sends a first message and receives a reply in the in-app thread.
Sees the agent in the roster and where it can be reached.

claims.statement: No account, credential or payment is requested before the agent has replied at least once.
claims.rationale: The entire argument for the in-app surface is that it is the only zero-setup path into the product.

claims.statement: A first reply is reachable in at most four interactions from a cold start.
